records.source: Location/Meet The Wizard/You received a letter from the local wizard. He claims to have information regarding the old community center./Enter the wizard's tower./WizardHouse/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Location/Kilalanin ang Mago/Nakatanggap ka ng liham mula sa lokal na Mago. Sinasabi niyang may impormasyon siya tungkol sa lumang Sentro ng Komunidad./Pumasok sa tore ng Mago./WizardHouse/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/The Mysterious Qi/Within a secret lock-box, you found a note with peculiar instructions. It's signed by a 'Mr. Qi'./Leave a rainbow shell in the box at the train platform./null/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Mahiwagang G. Qi/Sa loob ng isang lihim na kahong may kandado, nakakita ka ng tala na may kakaibang mga tagubilin. Nilagdaan ito ng “G. Qi”./Mag-iwan ng Kabibing Bahaghari sa kahon sa plataporma ng tren./null/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/The Mysterious Qi/You've found another note written by 'Mr. Qi'. The request is even more unusual this time./Place 10 beets inside Mayor Lewis' fridge./null/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Mahiwagang G. Qi/May natagpuan ka pang talang isinulat ni “G. Qi”. Mas kakaiba pa ang kahilingan ngayon./Maglagay ng 10 Beet sa loob ng pridyider ni Mayor Lewis./null/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/The Mysterious Qi/You've found yet another strange note within the Mayor's fridge. This time, the instructions are more cryptic./"Give the sand dragon his final meal."/null/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Mahiwagang G. Qi/May natagpuan ka na namang kakaibang tala sa loob ng pridyider ng Mayor. Mas palaisipan ang mga tagubilin ngayon./“Ibigay sa dragon ng buhangin ang huling pagkain nito.”/null/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/The Mysterious Qi/You found another note in the sand dragon's eye. It seems Mr. Qi's strange scavenger hunt has come to an end./Inspect the lumber pile beside your house./null/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Mahiwagang G. Qi/May natagpuan ka pang tala sa mata ng dragon ng buhangin. Mukhang natapos na ang kakaibang paghahanap ni G. Qi./Suriin ang bunton ng troso sa tabi ng bahay mo./null/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: ItemHarvest/Getting Started/If you want to become a farmer, you have to start with the basics. Use your hoe to till the soil, then use a seed packet on the tilled soil to sow a crop. Water every day until the crop is ready for harvest./Cultivate and harvest a parsnip./(O)24/h7 8/100/-1/true
records.translation: ItemHarvest/Pagsisimula/Kung gusto mong maging magsasaka, kailangan mong magsimula sa mga batayan. Gamitin ang Asarol upang bungkalin ang lupa, saka gumamit ng pakete ng binhi sa binungkal na lupa upang maghasik ng pananim. Diligan araw-araw hanggang maaari nang anihin ang pananim./Magtanim at umani ng parsnip./(O)24/h7 8/100/-1/true

records.source: Building/Raising Animals/Robin, the local carpenter, lives north of town. In exchange for raw materials and money, she'll construct new buildings on your farm. You'll need her to build a coop or barn so that you can raise animals./Build a Coop./Coop/-1/100/-1/true
records.translation: Building/Pag-aalaga ng mga Hayop/Nakatira sa hilaga ng bayan si Robin, ang lokal na karpintero. Kapalit ng mga hilaw na materyal at pera, magtatayo siya ng mga bagong gusali sa bukid mo. Kailangan mong ipagawa sa kanya ang Kulungan o Kamalig upang makapag-alaga ng mga hayop./Magtayo ng Kulungan./Coop/-1/100/-1/true
records.englishResidueReason: The remaining English word is the exact technical building identifier in the slash-delimited quest schema; all player-facing prose is translated.

records.source: Crafting/Advancement/As you gain experience, you'll discover new crafting recipes to increase profit and make life easier. A scarecrow, for example, will prevent crows from snacking on your precious crops./Reach Farming level 1 and craft a scarecrow./(BC)8/-1/100/-1/true
records.translation: Crafting/Pag-unlad/Habang nadaragdagan ang karanasan mo, matutuklasan mo ang mga bagong resipe sa paglikha upang dagdagan ang kita at padaliin ang buhay. Halimbawa, pipigilan ng panakot-uwak ang mga uwak na kainin ang mahahalaga mong pananim./Umabot sa antas 1 ng Pagsasaka at lumikha ng panakot-uwak./(BC)8/-1/100/-1/true

records.source: Social/Introductions/It would be a nice gesture to introduce yourself around town. Some people might be anxious to meet the new farmer././null/25/0/-1/true
records.translation: Social/Mga Pagpapakilala/Magandang asal ang magpakilala sa buong bayan. Baka sabik ang ilang tao na makilala ang bagong magsasaka././null/25/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Copper Ore/You found a piece of copper ore. You're not sure what you can use it for, but the local blacksmith ought to know./Bring a piece of copper ore to Clint's blacksmith shop././-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Mineral na Tanso/May natagpuan kang isang piraso ng mineral na tanso. Hindi mo tiyak kung saan ito magagamit, pero malamang ay alam ng lokal na panday./Magdala ng isang piraso ng mineral na tanso sa pandayan ni Clint././-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Crafting/Forging Ahead/If you're going to keep mining, you should build a furnace./Craft a Furnace./(BC)13/12/0/-1/true
records.translation: Crafting/Pagsulong sa Pagpapanday/Kung magpapatuloy ka sa pagmimina, dapat kang gumawa ng Pugon./Lumikha ng Pugon./(BC)13/12/0/-1/true

records.source: ItemHarvest/Smelting/Now that you've built a furnace, you can smelt some metal. According to Clint's instructions, if you place 5 copper ore and 1 piece of coal in the furnace, it should produce a copper bar./Use your furnace to smelt a Copper Bar./(O)334 1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: ItemHarvest/Pagtunaw/Ngayong nakagawa ka na ng Pugon, maaari kang tumunaw ng metal. Ayon sa mga tagubilin ni Clint, kapag naglagay ka ng 5 mineral na tanso at 1 piraso ng uling sa Pugon, dapat itong gumawa ng Lingoteng Tanso./Gamitin ang Pugon upang tunawin ang isang Lingoteng Tanso./(O)334 1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/To The Beach/Someone named Willy invited you to visit the beach south of town. He says he has something to give you./Visit the beach south of town before 5:00pm./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Patungo sa Dalampasigan/Inanyayahan ka ng isang nagngangalang Willy na dumalaw sa dalampasigan sa timog ng bayan. May ibibigay daw siya sa iyo./Dalawin ang dalampasigan sa timog ng bayan bago mag-alas-5:00 ng hapon./-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Explore The Mine/There's an old mine shaft in the mountains north of town. There could be valuable minerals inside, but Marlon hinted that it might be dangerous./Reach level 5 in the mines./17/17/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Galugarin ang Minahan/May lumang lagusan ng minahan sa kabundukan sa hilaga ng bayan. Baka may mahahalagang mineral sa loob, pero ipinahiwatig ni Marlon na maaaring mapanganib ito./Umabot sa antas 5 sa mga Minahan./17/17/0/-1/false

records.source: Monster/Initiation/If you can slay 10 slimes, you'll have earned your place in the Adventurer's Guild./0 of 10 slimes slain./Green_Slime 10 null false/16/0/-1/false
records.translation: Monster/Pagsisimula/Kapag nakapatay ka ng 10 Slime, magiging karapat-dapat kang sumapi sa Samahan ng mga Adventurer./0 sa 10 Slime ang napatay./Green_Slime 10 null false/16/0/-1/false

records.source: Location/Initiation/You successfully dispatched 10 slimes. Now you can enter the Adventurer's Guild./Enter the Adventurer's Guild./AdventureGuild/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Location/Pagsisimula/Matagumpay kang nakapatay ng 10 Slime. Maaari ka nang pumasok sa Samahan ng mga Adventurer./Pumasok sa Samahan ng mga Adventurer./AdventureGuild/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/Deeper In The Mine/It seems that the mine elevator is still functional. It will allow you to quickly return to any elevator doors you've discovered. A deeper expedition might be in order./Reach level 40 in the mines./18/18/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Mas Malalim sa Minahan/Mukhang gumagana pa rin ang elebeytor ng minahan. Mabilis ka nitong maibabalik sa anumang pintuan ng elebeytor na natuklasan mo. Marahil ay nararapat ang mas malalim na paglalakbay./Umabot sa antas 40 sa mga Minahan./18/18/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/To The Bottom?/So far, there's no sign of the bottom. How low does it go?/Reach the bottom of the mine./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Hanggang sa Pinakailalim?/Wala pang palatandaan ng pinakailalim. Gaano ba ito kalalim?/Abutin ang pinakailalim ng Minahan./-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/The Skull Key/You found a strange looking key in the bottom of the mines./Discover the purpose of the Skull Key./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Susi ng Bungo/Nakakita ka ng kakaibang susi sa pinakailalim ng mga Minahan./Tuklasin ang gamit ng Susi ng Bungo./-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/Qi's Challenge/You've been challenged to reach level 25 in the skull cavern. You've been promised a substantial reward if you're successful./Reach level 25 in the Skull Cavern./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Hamon ni G. Qi/Hinamon kang umabot sa antas 25 sa Yungib ng Bungo. Pinangakuan ka ng malaking gantimpala kung magtatagumpay ka./Umabot sa antas 25 sa Yungib ng Bungo./-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/Marnie's Request/Marnie came by the farm and asked if you'd bring her a cave carrot. She's trying to train her goats to speak, and cave carrot is their favorite snack./Bring a Cave Carrot into Marnie's shop./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Kahilingan ni Marnie/Dumaan si Marnie sa bukid at hiniling na dalhan mo siya ng Karot sa Yungib. Sinisikap niyang turuang magsalita ang mga kambing niya, at paborito nilang meryenda ang Karot sa Yungib./Magdala ng Karot sa Yungib sa tindahan ni Marnie./-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Fish Casserole/Jodi swung by the farm to ask you to dinner at 7:00 PM. Her only request was that you bring a largemouth bass for her fish casserole./Enter Jodi's house with a largemouth bass at 7:00 PM./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Kaserol na Isda/Dumaan si Jodi sa bukid upang anyayahan ka sa hapunan sa alas-7:00 ng gabi. Ang tanging hiling niya ay magdala ka ng Largemouth Bass para sa kaserol niyang isda./Pumasok sa bahay ni Jodi na may dalang Largemouth Bass sa alas-7:00 ng gabi./-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Location/Archaeology/You found an ancient-looking object. Could it be some kind of artifact from long ago? Perhaps Gunther, curator of the local museum, has the answer./Visit Gunther at the museum./ArchaeologyHouse/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Location/Arkeolohiya/May natagpuan kang bagay na mukhang napakatanda. Isa kaya itong artepakto mula noong unang panahon? Baka alam ni Gunther, ang tagapangasiwa ng lokal na museo, ang sagot./Dalawin si Gunther sa museo./ArchaeologyHouse/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Archaeology/Gunther asked if you'd consider donating any new artifacts or minerals you find to the museum. He says he'll compensate you by way of occasional rare goods./Donate an artifact or a mineral to the museum./-1/-1/250/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Arkeolohiya/Tinanong ka ni Gunther kung maaari mong ibigay sa museo ang anumang bagong artepakto o mineral na matatagpuan mo. Sinabi niyang gagantimpalaan ka niya paminsan-minsan ng mga pambihirang bagay./Magbigay ng artepakto o mineral sa museo./-1/-1/250/-1/true

records.source: Basic/How To Win Friends/Giving gifts is a great way to build friendships. Learn each person's individual tastes and you'll be popular in no time./Give someone a gift./-1/-1/100/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Paano Magkaroon ng mga Kaibigan/Mahusay na paraan ang pagbibigay ng mga regalo upang bumuo ng pagkakaibigan. Alamin ang natatanging panlasa ng bawat tao at mabilis kang sisikat./Bigyan ng regalo ang isang tao./-1/-1/100/-1/true

records.source: Basic/"Rat Problem"/There's something odd going on in the Community Center.../Investigate the Community Center/-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/“Problema sa Daga”/May kakaibang nangyayari sa Sentro ng Komunidad.../Imbestigahan ang Sentro ng Komunidad/-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Goblin Problem/There's a goblin blocking the path to the Witch's hut. There must be some way to get him to move... Perhaps I should seek out more information on Goblins./Gain entrance to the Witch's hut./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Problema sa Goblin/May Goblin na humaharang sa daan papunta sa Kubo ng Mangkukulam. Tiyak na may paraan upang mapaalis siya... Baka dapat akong maghanap ng higit pang impormasyon tungkol sa mga Goblin./Makapasok sa Kubo ng Mangkukulam./-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Dark Talisman/The Wizard asked me to retrieve the magic ink from his ex-wife's house... but to gain access I'll need a dark talisman./Enter the sewer and ask Krobus about the dark talisman./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Maitim na Anting-anting/Hiniling ng Mago na kunin ko ang mahiwagang tinta mula sa bahay ng dati niyang asawa... pero kailangan ko ng Maitim na Anting-anting upang makapasok./Pumasok sa Imburnal at tanungin si Krobus tungkol sa Maitim na Anting-anting./-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Basic/Strange Note/You found a note, barely legible, asking you to bring "may-pal serrup" to the "seecrit wuds"./Bring "may-pal serrup" to the "seecrit wuds"/-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Kakaibang Tala/May natagpuan kang halos hindi mabasang tala na humihiling na dalhin mo ang “mey-pol sirap” sa “sikret wuds”./Dalhin ang “mey-pol sirap” sa “sikret wuds”/-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/Cryptic Note/You found a note that reads, "Someone is waiting for you on level 100 in the Skull Cavern"/Reach level 100 in the Skull Cavern/-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Palaisipang Tala/May natagpuan kang talang nagsasabing, “May naghihintay sa iyo sa antas 100 ng Yungib ng Bungo”/Umabot sa antas 100 sa Yungib ng Bungo/-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: Basic/A Winter Mystery/You encountered a suspicious looking figure by the bus stop. When it saw you, it fled toward town. Could there be a clue to its whereabouts?/Find the shadowy figure./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Isang Hiwaga sa Taglamig/May nakasalubong kang kahina-hinalang anyo sa tabi ng hintuan ng bus. Nang makita ka nito, tumakas ito patungo sa bayan. May palatandaan kaya kung nasaan ito?/Hanapin ang anyong tila anino./-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: LostItem/Robin's Lost Axe/Robin lost her favorite axe. The last time she remembers using it, she was cutting wood south of Marnie's ranch./Find Robin's lost axe./Robin (O)788 Forest 110 81/-1/250/-1/true/Hey, you found my axe! What a relief... I almost chopped my toe off with the other one I was using. Thank you!
records.translation: LostItem/Nawawalang Palakol ni Robin/Nawala ni Robin ang paborito niyang Palakol. Noong huli niya itong nagamit, namumutol siya ng kahoy sa timog ng rantso ni Marnie./Hanapin ang nawawalang Palakol ni Robin./Robin (O)788 Forest 110 81/-1/250/-1/true/Uy, nahanap mo ang Palakol ko! Kaylaking ginhawa... Halos maputol ko ang daliri ko sa paa gamit ang isa pang ginagamit ko. Salamat!

records.source: ItemDelivery/Jodi's Request/Jodi needs a fresh cauliflower for a recipe she's making. She's asking you to bring her one./Bring Jodi a cauliflower./Jodi (O)190/-1/350/-1/true/Oh, that looks so delicious! Thank you, this is just what I wanted. It's going to be perfect for my yellow curry.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Kahilingan ni Jodi/Kailangan ni Jodi ng sariwang Koliplor para sa resipeng ginagawa niya. Hinihiling niyang dalhan mo siya ng isa./Dalhan si Jodi ng Koliplor./Jodi (O)190/-1/350/-1/true/Ah, mukhang napakasarap niyan! Salamat, ito mismo ang gusto ko. Magiging perpekto ito para sa dilaw kong curry.

records.source: LostItem/Mayor's "Shorts"/Mayor Lewis has lost his purple "shorts". He's asking you to find and return them... Discreetly./Find and return Mayor Lewis' purple shorts./Lewis (O)789 AnimalShop 13 7/-1/750/-1/true/You found them... where? ...Oh!...Uhmm...Heh.#$b#There? I have no idea how they could've gotten there...*cough*#$b#This stays between you and me. Got it?$u
records.translation: LostItem/“Shorts” ng Mayor/Nawala ni Mayor Lewis ang kaniyang lilang “shorts”. Hinihiling niyang hanapin at ibalik mo ang mga iyon... Nang palihim./Hanapin at ibalik ang lilang shorts ni Mayor Lewis./Lewis (O)789 AnimalShop 13 7/-1/750/-1/true/Nakita mo ang mga iyon... saan? ...Ah!...Uhm...Heh.#$b#Doon? Hindi ko alam kung paano napunta roon ang mga iyon...*ubo*#$b#Sa ating dalawa lang ito. Maliwanag?$u

records.source: ItemDelivery/Pam Is Thirsty/Pam is hankerin' for a pale ale. Regular old beer won't do. You can brew one yourself if you have hops and a keg./Bring Pam a pale ale./Pam (O)303/-1/350/-1/true/Gimme that. *slurp*... Ahh, that's the stuff.#$b#It's real nice and hoppy... notes of citrus and pine, but with a robust body to keep it grounded.#$b#Thanks, kid. This means a lot to me. I knew I could count on you.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Nauuhaw si Pam/Naghahanap si Pam ng Maputlang Ale. Hindi sapat ang karaniwang serbesa. Maaari kang gumawa nito kung mayroon kang hops at Bariles./Dalhan si Pam ng Maputlang Ale./Pam (O)303/-1/350/-1/true/Ibigay mo sa akin. *lagok*... Ahh, ito ang gusto ko.#$b#Talagang masarap at malasa sa hops... may bahid ng citrus at pino, pero malinamnam at buo ang lasa.#$b#Salamat, bata. Napakahalaga nito sa akin. Alam kong maaasahan kita.$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Crop Research/Demetrius needs a fresh melon for his research./Bring Demetrius a melon./Demetrius (O)254/-1/550/-1/true/This is perfect! It's just what I need for my research. It's going to be hard not to eat it! Thanks a bunch.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Pananaliksik sa Pananim/Kailangan ni Demetrius ng sariwang melon para sa pananaliksik niya./Dalhan si Demetrius ng melon./Demetrius (O)254/-1/550/-1/true/Perpekto ito! Ito mismo ang kailangan ko sa pananaliksik ko. Mahirap pigilang kainin ito! Maraming salamat.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Knee Therapy/George needs a hot pepper to soothe his aching knee./Bring George a Hot Pepper./George (O)260/-1/200/-1/true/Took you long enough... hmmph... Well it's good and spicy at least. Thanks.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Terapiya sa Tuhod/Kailangan ni George ng Maanghang na Sili upang paginhawahin ang masakit niyang tuhod./Dalhan si George ng Maanghang na Sili./George (O)260/-1/200/-1/true/Ang tagal mo... hmph... Mabuti na lang at maanghang ito. Salamat.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Cow's Delight/Marnie wants to give her cows a special treat. She's asking for a single bunch of amaranth./Bring Marnie one bunch of amaranth./Marnie (O)300/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, the amaranth I asked for! Thank you so much... my cows are going to love this!$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Ligaya ng Baka/Gusto ni Marnie na bigyan ng natatanging meryenda ang mga baka niya. Humihingi siya ng isang bungkos ng Amaranto./Dalhan si Marnie ng isang bungkos ng Amaranto./Marnie (O)300/-1/500/-1/true/Ah, ang Amaranto na hiniling ko! Maraming-maraming salamat... Magugustuhan ito ng mga baka ko!$h

records.source: LostItem/Blackberry Basket/It's blackberry season, but Linus can't find his basket! He's asking you to help him find it. He has no idea where it is./Find Linus' basket and return it to him./Linus (O)790 Backwoods 27 27/-1/0/-1/true/My basket! Thank you. This means a lot to me.$h
records.translation: LostItem/Basket ng Blackberry/Panahon na ng blackberry, pero hindi mahanap ni Linus ang basket niya! Hinihiling niyang tulungan mo siyang hanapin iyon. Wala siyang ideya kung nasaan ito./Hanapin ang basket ni Linus at ibalik iyon sa kanya./Linus (O)790 Backwoods 27 27/-1/0/-1/true/Ang basket ko! Salamat. Napakahalaga nito sa akin.$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Carving Pumpkins/Caroline wants to carve a pumpkin with her daughter. She asked you to bring her one from the farm./Bring Caroline a pumpkin./Caroline (O)276/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, the pumpkin! It's a good one... Abigail will be so happy when she sees this. Thanks, @!$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Pag-ukit ng mga Kalabasa/Gusto ni Caroline na mag-ukit ng kalabasa kasama ang anak niyang babae. Hiniling niyang dalhan mo siya ng isa mula sa bukid./Dalhan si Caroline ng kalabasa./Caroline (O)276/-1/500/-1/true/Ah, ang kalabasa! Maganda ito... Matutuwa nang husto si Abigail kapag nakita niya ito. Salamat, @!$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Catch A Squid/Willy is challenging you to catch a squid. He says you can fish them from the ocean on winter nights./Bring Willy a squid./Willy (O)151/-1/800/-1/true/Hey, you did it! Not bad. Not bad at all. I'm impressed.#$b#Winter's a good time to break out the old fishing rod, isn't it?
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Manghuli ng Pusit/Hinamon ka ni Willy na manghuli ng pusit. Sinabi niyang mahuhuli ang mga iyon sa karagatan tuwing gabi ng taglamig./Dalhan si Willy ng pusit./Willy (O)151/-1/800/-1/true/Uy, nagawa mo! Hindi masama. Hindi talaga masama. Hanga ako.#$b#Magandang panahon ang taglamig para ilabas ang lumang pamingwit, hindi ba?

records.source: ItemDelivery/Clint's Attempt/Clint wants you to give Emily an amethyst. He wants you to tell her it's from him./Bring Emily an Amethyst./Emily (O)66/-1/0/-1/true/Oh, my favorite stone! You're so sweet!$h#$b#Huh? It's from who?$u#$b#Oh, you got it at Clint's? Well I don't care where you got it from, it's beautiful! Thank you! *smooch*$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Pagtatangka ni Clint/Gusto ni Clint na bigyan mo si Emily ng ametista. Gusto niyang sabihin mong mula sa kanya iyon./Dalhan si Emily ng Ametista./Emily (O)66/-1/0/-1/true/Ah, ang paborito kong bato! Napakabait mo!$h#$b#Huh? Galing kanino?$u#$b#Ah, nakuha mo ito sa tindahan ni Clint? Wala akong pakialam kung saan mo ito nakuha, napakaganda nito! Salamat! *tsup*$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/A Dark Reagent/The wizard wants you to descend into the mines and fetch him a Void Essence. He needs it for some kind of dark magic./Bring Wizard a Void Essence./Wizard (O)769/-1/1000/-1/true/Ah, you've brought it. You've earned my gratitude, and a 1000g reward. Now go.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Isang Maitim na Reagent/Gusto ng Mago na bumaba ka sa mga Minahan at kunin para sa kanya ang Esensiya ng Kawalan. Kailangan niya iyon para sa isang uri ng maitim na mahika./Dalhan ang Mago ng Esensiya ng Kawalan./Wizard (O)769/-1/1000/-1/true/Ah, dinala mo iyon. Nakamit mo ang pasasalamat ko at gantimpalang 1000g. Umalis ka na.

records.source: ItemDelivery/A Favor For Clint/Clint got a new hammer and he wants to test it out on a variety of metals./Bring Clint an Iron Bar./Clint (O)335/-1/500/-1/true/Hey, it's the iron bar I asked for. It looks strong... perfect.#$b#Thanks, @. I appreciate this.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Isang Pabor para kay Clint/May bagong martilyo si Clint at gusto niya itong subukan sa sari-saring metal./Dalhan si Clint ng Lingoteng Bakal./Clint (O)335/-1/500/-1/true/Uy, ito ang Lingoteng Bakal na hiniling ko. Mukhang matibay... perpekto.#$b#Salamat, @. Pinahahalagahan ko ito.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Robin's Request/Robin wrote to you asking for some hardwood./Bring Robin 10 pieces of Hardwood./Robin (O)709 10/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, you brought it! I know I can always count on you, @.$h#$b#Mmhmm... This wood is perfect. It's exactly what I need. Thanks!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Kahilingan ni Robin/Sumulat sa iyo si Robin upang humingi ng Matigas na Kahoy./Dalhan si Robin ng 10 piraso ng Matigas na Kahoy./Robin (O)709 10/-1/500/-1/true/Ah, dinala mo iyon! Alam kong lagi kitang maaasahan, @.$h#$b#Mmhmm... Perpekto ang kahoy na ito. Ito mismo ang kailangan ko. Salamat!

records.source: ItemDelivery/Fish Stew/Gus wants to make fish stew, but he needs an albacore./Bring Gus an Albacore./Gus (O)705/-1/400/-1/true/*sniff*...*sniff*... What's that? Something smells like albacore!#$b#Aha! You brought it! Thanks a million!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Nilagang Isda/Gustong gumawa ni Gus ng nilagang isda, pero kailangan niya ng Albakora./Dalhan si Gus ng Albakora./Gus (O)705/-1/400/-1/true/*singhot*...*singhot*... Ano iyon? May amoy Albakora!#$b#Aha! Dinala mo iyon! Maraming-maraming salamat!

records.source: ItemDelivery/Fresh Fruit/Emily wants a taste of spring. She's asking for a fresh apricot./Bring Emily an Apricot./Emily (O)634/-1/600/-1/true/Oh... You followed through! Thanks, this looks delicious!$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Sariwang Prutas/Gusto ni Emily na malasahan ang tagsibol. Humihingi siya ng sariwang Aprikot./Dalhan si Emily ng Aprikot./Emily (O)634/-1/600/-1/true/Ah... Tinupad mo iyon! Salamat, mukhang masarap ito!$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Granny's Gift/Evelyn wants to surprise her husband with a gift./Bring Evelyn a Leek./Evelyn (O)20/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, thank you, dear. This leek looks delicious. George will be so happy.#$b#He loves when I make eggs with leeks for breakfast.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Regalo ni Lola/Gusto ni Evelyn na sorpresahin ang asawa niya ng regalo./Dalhan si Evelyn ng Leek./Evelyn (O)20/-1/500/-1/true/Ah, salamat, mahal. Mukhang masarap ang Leek na ito. Matutuwa nang husto si George.#$b#Gustong-gusto niya kapag nagluluto ako ng mga itlog na may Leek para sa almusal.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Pierre's Notice/Pierre will pay "top coin" to whoever brings him a plate of sashimi. Apparently he's really craving the stuff./Bring Pierre some Sashimi./Pierre (O)227/-1/1000/-1/true/It's about time! I was starting to get the shakes, I wanted this fish so bad. *munch*... Mmm, now that's good.#$b#Thanks, @.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Abiso ni Pierre/Magbabayad si Pierre ng “pinakamataas na halaga” sa sinumang magdadala sa kanya ng isang plato ng sashimi. Mukhang talagang hinahanap-hanap niya iyon./Dalhan si Pierre ng Sashimi./Pierre (O)227/-1/1000/-1/true/Sa wakas! Nagsisimula na akong manginig, gustong-gusto ko nang kainin ang isdang ito. *ngasab*... Mmm, napakasarap niyan.#$b#Salamat, @.$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Aquatic Research/Demetrius is studying the toxin levels of the local pufferfish. He'd like you to bring him one./Bring Demetrius a Pufferfish./Demetrius (O)128/-1/1000/-1/true/There you are. The specimen looks perfect. I'm going to get it on ice straight away. Thanks, @!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Pananaliksik sa Tubig/Pinag-aaralan ni Demetrius ang antas ng lason sa lokal na Isdang Buntal. Gusto niyang dalhan mo siya ng isa./Dalhan si Demetrius ng Isdang Buntal./Demetrius (O)128/-1/1000/-1/true/Heto na. Mukhang perpekto ang espesimen. Ilalagay ko agad ito sa yelo. Salamat, @!

records.source: ItemDelivery/A Soldier's Star/Kent wants to give his wife a starfruit for their anniversary./Bring Kent a Starfruit./Kent (O)268/-1/500/-1/true/Hey. Shhh... Don't let Jodi see.#$b#Ah, this looks juicy. She'll love it. Thank you so much.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Bituin ng Isang Sundalo/Gusto ni Kent na bigyan ang asawa niya ng Balimbing para sa anibersaryo nila./Dalhan si Kent ng Balimbing./Kent (O)268/-1/500/-1/true/Uy. Shhh... Huwag mong ipakita kay Jodi.#$b#Ah, mukhang makatas ito. Gustong-gusto niya ito. Maraming-maraming salamat.$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Mayor's Need/Mayor Lewis wants truffle oil. He won't explain what it's for. Maybe it's none of your business./Bring Lewis a bottle of Truffle Oil./Lewis (O)432/-1/750/-1/true/You got the oil? Let me see...#$b#It's high quality... very slick. Great. Thank you.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Pangangailangan ng Mayor/Gusto ni Mayor Lewis ng langis ng truffle. Ayaw niyang ipaliwanag kung para saan iyon. Baka hindi mo na dapat pakialaman iyon./Dalhan si Lewis ng isang bote ng Langis ng Truffle./Lewis (O)432/-1/750/-1/true/Nakuha mo ang langis? Tingnan ko...#$b#Mataas ang kalidad... napakadulas. Mahusay. Salamat.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Wanted: Lobster/Gus put out a notice requesting a fresh lobster./Bring Gus a Lobster./Gus (O)715/-1/800/-1/true/Something smells like fresh lobster. Oh, that's good.$h#$b#Take care, friend.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Hinahanap: Lobster/Naglagay si Gus ng abisong humihiling ng sariwang Lobster./Dalhan si Gus ng Lobster./Gus (O)715/-1/800/-1/true/May naaamoy akong sariwang Lobster. Ah, napakasarap niyan.$h#$b#Mag-ingat ka, kaibigan.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Pam Needs Juice/Pam's TV Remote is dead. She's having a tough time going back and forth between the couch and the TV dial./Bring Pam a Battery Pack./Pam (O)787/-1/400/-1/true/Hey, you pulled through with the battery pack! Thanks, kid... You're a life-saver!$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Kailangan ni Pam ng Kuryente/Patay na ang remote ng telebisyon ni Pam. Nahihirapan siyang magparoo’t parito sa sofa at pihitan ng telebisyon./Dalhan si Pam ng Pakete ng Baterya./Pam (O)787/-1/400/-1/true/Uy, nakuha mo ang Pakete ng Baterya! Salamat, bata... Tagapagligtas ka!$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Staff Of Power/The Wizard is creating a staff of phenomenal power. Who knows what it's for. He needs an iridium bar to finish it./Bring Wizard an Iridium Bar./Wizard (O)337/-1/5000/-1/true/Ah, precious iridium. You've done well, @. You have my gratitude. Now, leave.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Tungkod ng Kapangyarihan/Lumilikha ang Mago ng tungkod na may pambihirang kapangyarihan. Walang nakaaalam kung para saan iyon. Kailangan niya ng lingote ng iridyum upang tapusin ito./Dalhan ang Mago ng Lingoteng Iridyum./Wizard (O)337/-1/5000/-1/true/Ah, mahalagang iridyum. Mahusay ang ginawa mo, @. Nagpapasalamat ako. Umalis ka na.

records.source: ItemDelivery/Catch a Lingcod/Willy is challenging you to catch a Lingcod./Bring Willy a Lingcod./Willy (O)707/-1/550/-1/true/Hey, that's a real lunker! You've certainly got the angler's blood in you.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Manghuli ng Lingcod/Hinamon ka ni Willy na manghuli ng Lingcod./Dalhan si Willy ng Lingcod./Willy (O)707/-1/550/-1/true/Uy, talagang dambuhala iyan! Tiyak na dumadaloy sa iyo ang dugo ng isang mangingisda.$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Exotic Spirits/Gus wants to make a Coco-no-no, but he's missing the main ingredient./Bring Gus a Coconut./Gus (O)88/-1/600/-1/true/Coconut! Now there's a soothing sight for my winter eyes.$h#$b#It's going to be perfect for my coco-no-no. Thanks!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Mga Eksotikong Inumin/Gustong gumawa ni Gus ng Coco-no-no, pero kulang siya sa pangunahing sangkap./Dalhan si Gus ng Niyog./Gus (O)88/-1/600/-1/true/Niyog! Kaygandang tanawin para sa mga mata ko ngayong taglamig.$h#$b#Magiging perpekto ito para sa Coco-no-no ko. Salamat!

records.source: ItemDelivery/Errand for your Wife/Your wife asked you to bring her 200 pieces of fiber for a secret project./Bring Emily 200 fiber./Emily (O)771 200/-1/0/-1/false/Oh, this looks perfect... and it's sustainably sourced, too! Thanks so much, @.$h#$b#Now, I've got my work cut out for me. It'll be a few more days before it's ready...
records.translation: ItemDelivery/Utos ng Asawa Mo/Hiniling ng asawa mong babae na dalhan mo siya ng 200 piraso ng hibla para sa isang lihim na proyekto./Dalhan si Emily ng 200 hibla./Emily (O)771 200/-1/0/-1/false/Ah, mukhang perpekto ito... at mula rin ito sa napapanatiling mapagkukunan! Maraming salamat, @.$h#$b#Ngayon, marami akong kailangang gawin. Ilang araw pa bago ito maging handa...

records.source: Basic/Haley's Cake-Walk/Your wife is organizing a charity cake-walk in the town square. She asked you to bring a chocolate cake./Enter Town on a sunny morning with a chocolate cake./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/Palarong Keyk ni Haley/Nag-oorganisa ang asawa mong babae ng mapagkawanggawang palarong keyk sa liwasan ng bayan. Hiniling niyang dalhan mo siya ng Keyk na Tsokolate./Pumasok sa Bayan sa isang maaraw na umaga nang may Keyk na Tsokolate./-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Abigail (O)191 100 129/-1/0/-1/false/That necklace! Where did you find it?$7#$b#Well, thanks for bringing it to me, @. My mom will never know...$h
records.translation: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Abigail (O)191 100 129/-1/0/-1/false/Ang kuwintas na iyon! Saan mo nakita iyon?$7#$b#Aba, salamat sa pagdala nito sa akin, @. Hindi kailanman malalaman ni Nanay...$h

records.source: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Caroline (O)191 50 128/-1/0/-1/false/What's this? My old necklace?$s#$b#That's strange, I didn't even notice it was missing... Well, thanks for bringing it back, @.$h
records.translation: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Caroline (O)191 50 128/-1/0/-1/false/Ano ito? Ang luma kong kuwintas?$s#$b#Kakaiba, hindi ko man lang napansing nawawala iyon... Aba, salamat sa pagbalik nito, @.$h

records.source: Basic/The Pirate's Wife/An old lady living on Ginger Island is asking you to find a keepsake of her husband's. She gave you an old photograph of a soldier that washed up on shore, hoping it would help in some way./Find a keepsake that belonged to Birdie's husband./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Asawa ng Pirata/Hinihiling ng isang matandang babaeng nakatira sa Isla ng Luya na hanapin mo ang isang bagay na nagpapaalala sa asawa niya. Binigyan ka niya ng lumang larawan ng isang sundalo na inanod sa pampang, sa pag-asang makatutulong iyon./Maghanap ng alaalang bagay na pag-aari ng asawa ni Birdie./-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Fishing/Willy's Challenge/Willy has challenged you to catch 3 Sandfish./Catch 3 Sandfish./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Fishing/Hamon ni Willy/Hinamon ka ni Willy na manghuli ng 3 Sandfish./Manghuli ng 3 Sandfish./-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: ItemHarvest/Getting Started/If you want to become a farmer, you have to start with the basics. Feed your chickens each day by letting them eat grass outside, or by placing hay into their troughs. Once they are mature, harvest an egg!/Harvest an egg from your chickens./-5/h8 133/100/-1/true
records.translation: ItemHarvest/Pagsisimula/Kung gusto mong maging magsasaka, kailangan mong magsimula sa mga batayan. Pakainin ang mga manok mo araw-araw sa pamamagitan ng pagpapastol sa kanila sa damo sa labas o paglalagay ng pakain sa kanilang mga labangan. Kapag malalaki na sila, mangolekta ng itlog!/Mangolekta ng itlog mula sa mga manok mo./-5/h8 133/100/-1/true

records.source: Building/Feeding Animals/Robin, the local carpenter, lives north of town. In exchange for raw materials and money, she'll construct new buildings on your farm. If you build a silo, you can start harvesting your own grass with the scythe, and store it to feed your animals./Build a Silo./Silo/-1/100/-1/true
records.translation: Building/Pagpapakain sa mga Hayop/Nakatira sa hilaga ng bayan si Robin, ang lokal na karpintero. Kapalit ng mga hilaw na materyal at pera, magtatayo siya ng mga bagong gusali sa bukid mo. Kapag nagtayo ka ng Silo, maaari mo nang anihin ang sarili mong damo gamit ang karit at iimbak iyon bilang pakain sa mga hayop mo./Magtayo ng Silo./Silo/-1/100/-1/true
records.englishResidueReason: The remaining English word is the exact technical building identifier in the slash-delimited quest schema; all player-facing prose is translated.

records.source: Basic/The Giant Stump/The big tree to the south of my farm blew down. With 100 hardwood, I could turn the stump into something interesting.../Fix up the giant stump./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/Ang Dambuhalang Tuod/Bumagsak ang malaking puno sa timog ng bukid ko. Gamit ang 100 Matigas na Kahoy, maaari kong gawing isang bagay na interesante ang tuod.../Ayusin ang dambuhalang tuod./-1/-1/0/-1/false
